# The team format

A squad, as a QR code the app scans. One JSON object:

```json
{
  "format": "ptb.team/1",
  "players": [
    { "number": 7, "name": "Luca", "position": "RW" }
  ]
}
```

Every player needs all three fields. There is nothing else in the format - no photographs, no
contact details, no date of birth. A tactics board needs a number to draw and a name to say.

## Limits

| | |
|---|---|
| Shirt number | whole number, `1`-`99`, and unique across the squad |
| Name | 1-40 characters |
| Players | at most 60 |

Two players on the same number is refused rather than quietly resolved, because the list is the
coach's and only they know which of the two is wrong.

## Positions

| | |
|---|---|
| Goalkeeper | `GK` |
| Defenders | `CB`, `RB`, `LB`, `RWB`, `LWB`, `SW` |
| Midfielders | `CDM`, `CM`, `CAM`, `RM`, `LM`, `RW`, `LW` |
| Forwards | `ST`, `CF`, `RF`, `LF` |
| Other | `NA` |

`NA` is the honest answer when the source list does not say. It is better than guessing: a wrong
position puts a player in the wrong part of a formation when the board lays one out.

## Names

Prefer what the coach would shout across a pitch. A first name, or initials and a surname, is
usually enough to tell one player from another, and it is what fits under a disc on the board -
a name is drawn wider than the shirt it belongs to.

This also keeps the list proportionate. Whatever is pasted into the conversation reaches whichever
assistant is being used, and a youth squad list is a page of children's names. Say so once, suggest
first names, and then write the list the way the coach asks for it - it is their squad.

## Worked examples

In `examples/teams/`, both validated when this file was generated.

| file | players | code length |
|---|---|---|
| `teams/01-under-13-squad.json` | 13 | 284 |
| `teams/02-futsal-five.json` | 7 | 216 |

A code is made the same way a drill code is:

```bash
python3 scripts/make_qr.py examples/teams/01-under-13-squad.json -o team-code.png
```

`make_qr.py` reads the `format` field and checks the payload against the right rules, so the same
command takes either a drill or a team.
